import nanosurf, time, os, numpy as np

# Initialize SPM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application
scan = app.Scan
opmode = app.OperatingMode
zctrl = app.ZController

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6
scan.Points = 128
scan.Lines = 128
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # time per line in seconds
# Center position (optional, keep current)
# Set operating mode to tapping (minimize tip damage)
# Assuming opmode.Mode attribute exists; set to 'Tapping'

    opmode.Mode = 'Tapping'
else:
    # fallback: set to a known constant if defined
    try:
        opmode.Mode = opmode.Tapping
    except Exception:
